definitionZh: : 定义 CSS 伪类代表任何已定义的元素. 这包括浏览器中包含的任何标准元素和已成功定义的自定义元素(即使用CustomElementRegistry.define()方法).
sourceDefinition: The :defined CSS pseudo-class represents any element that has been defined. This includes any standard element built into the browser and custom elements that have been successfully defined (i.e., with the CustomElementRegistry.define() method).

sourceEvidence.sourceDefinition: The :defined CSS pseudo-class represents any element that has been defined. This includes any standard element built into the browser and custom elements that have been successfully defined (i.e., with the CustomElementRegistry.define() method).
